title: The lane classifier is extension point lane: extensions.lane wins over lane_module, which stays a supported key for the kb's own kblane
goal: bl_base.lane(root) returns the lane module through kbext.load as the one reader for bl_land.unlanded_code and bl_precheck.after_merge_proof; extensions.lane names a module with kblane's path_lane and commit_paths and wins over backlog.json's lane_module; lane_module stays a supported key of API 1 so backlog.json, the skills and the worker role keep their wording; with neither set bl_base.lane returns None and there is no code lane as now

clauses.clause: bl_base.lane(root) returns the lane module through kbext.load as the one reader for bl_land.unlanded_code and bl_precheck.after_merge_proof
extensions.lane names a module with kblane's path_lane and commit_paths and wins over backlog.json's lane_module
lane_module stays a supported key of API 1 so backlog.json, the skills and the worker role keep their wording
with neither set bl_base.lane returns None and there is no code lane as now
